entities.name: Restoration of Balance
entities.description: Event in which the division between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor was re-stabilized after Isilu's awakening and the elves' attempt to impose eternal day.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A primal night elemental whose awakening unbalanced Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The day elemental whose interaction with Isilu restores equilibrium.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A ruler haunted by fears of being the reborn Oona, poisoned by Rhys and cured by Oko.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Former Shadowmoor ruler whose rebirth Maralen fears.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Maralen's long-lost brother and a former creation of Oona who returns to help cure her.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Bound to Maralen's life; poisons her with a moonglove blade and later dissolves.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: Leader of the elves of Lys Alana seeking permanent day.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: Strixhaven student who guides Eirdu back to the battlefield.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: Strixhaven student who helps recover dawnglove.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: Strixhaven student critically wounded in the battle.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: Strixhaven student who helps recover dawnglove.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: Helps recover a vial of dawnglove from Morcant.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who heals Tam and guides the students back to Arcavios.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: Elves who try to impose eternal day.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane alternating between day and night aspects.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Home plane of the Strixhaven students.

events.summary: Strixhaven students arrive via an Omenpath, awakening Isilu and destabilizing the plane.
events.quote: Their arrival brough about the disturbance and awakening of Isilu

events.summary: The elves of Lys Alana under Morcant try to destroy Isilu with weaponized dawnglove to force permanent day.
events.quote: intending to establish a permanent day across the plane

events.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with a moonglove-poisoned blade to prevent Oona's return, leaving her dying.
events.quote: she was ultimately struck by Rhys with a moonglove-poisoned blade

events.summary: Oko returns, revealed as Maralen's brother, and with Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen recovers dawnglove from Morcant.
events.quote: a vial of dawnglove was recovered from Morcant

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu confront each other in a ritualized dance, ending the instability.
events.quote: Eirdu and Isilu confronted one another in a controlled, reciprocal display of power

events.summary: Oko cures Maralen with the dawnglove; Ajani helps heal Tam.
events.quote: Oko used the recovered dawnglove to cure Maralen

events.summary: Rhys loses his bond to Maralen and dissolves.
Ajani guides the stranded students back to Arcavios.
events.quote: The stranded students were subsequently guided back to Arcavios by Ajani

relations.quote: revealed to be Maralen's long-lost brother and a former creation of Oona
the elves of Lys Alana , led by Morcant
